text: This report provides information and identifies a preliminary set of issues regarding the application located at 33, 37, 39, 41 and 43 Centre Avenue. Staff are currently reviewing the application. It has been circulated to all appropriate agencies and City divisions for comment. Staff will proceed to schedule a community consultation meeting for the application with the Ward Councillor.

North York Community Council: 1. Referred the report (February 5, 2021) from the Acting Director, Community Planning, North York District back to staff for further discussion with the applicant and a report back to Community Council on whether the applicant has addressed the concerns that have been raised with them on multiple occasions.
